thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: continuous-batching / KV cache regression detected. Metric: kv_cache_evictions per-second spiking x15 for MQA/GQA workloads on Llama and Mistral clusters. Elevated tail latency on Qwen too. Auto-escalation to #incidents. Runbook: https://playbooks.redwood/kv-batching

sara: acked. I'm oncall. pinging eng-runtime and eng-ml. quick check: are we seeing a recent config push?

alex: looking. I see a config rollout at 03:12 UTC that changed batch_window_ms from 10 -> 80ms in batcher-configmap (targeting continuous batching improvements). Rolling average batch size jumped and KV cache churn went up.

mike: confirming from prometheus: 
```
rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[1m]) > 2000 (normally ~120)
p90_latency_tokens > 350ms -> jumped to 900-1.2s
models_affected{model=~".*mistral.*|.*llama.*|.*qwen.*"}
```

alex: hypothesis: longer batch window increased prefix/spillover causing more unique KV keys kept warm briefly -> cache churn -> evictions -> higher KV fetch latency -> token-level tail. GQA/MQA fragmentation exacerbates it because of model-specific kv-key prefixes.

sara: immediate mitigation: revert batch_window_ms to 10ms for prod batcher pool, and temporarily disable continuous_batching for MQA routes. Can we patch and restart with minimal blast radius?

deploy-bot: Starting controlled config patch - canary 10% to pool "batcher-prod". Using deployment/batcher-configmap v2026.03.15-hotfix

alex: command I will run (will annotate in thread):
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/batcher BATCH_WINDOW_MS=10 --record
kubectl -n inference patch deployment batcher -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"hotfix":"1842103456-revert-batch-window"}}}}}'
```

mike: I'm watching grafana panels: eviction rate falling on canary after ~35s. tail latency p95 from 1.1s -> 420ms. Progressive rollout?

jenny: support notif: sending interim status to affected customers (orgs with sustained errors >5m). Draft below, please thumbs-up: 
"Hi — we observed increased request latency/partial errors for embedding and chat routes on some models. We're rolling a hotfix to revert a batching config change and will follow up with root-cause. Impact: higher latency and occasional 5xxs for embeddings on Llama/Mistral. ETA for full mitigation: ~20 minutes."

sara: :thumbsup: send. Also add note to include temporary mitigation steps for customers (retry/backoff).

deploy-bot: Canary healthy. Rolling to 50% now.

ops-bot: alert: error rate for route /v1/embeddings (customer-tier=standard) down from 4.8% -> 1.2% after canary. Continuing rollout.

alex: follow-up config to limit batch size to 8 tokens max for MQA-heavy model-mappings to reduce KV key diversity: snippet: 
```
route_overrides:
  - matcher: "model:.*mistral.*|.*llama.*"
    continuous_batching: false
  - matcher: "model:.*qwen.*"
    max_batch_tokens: 8
```

mike: after full rollout (T+12m) metrics look good. Evictions baseline back to normal, p95 latency ~250-300ms. No new 5xx spikes.

sara: great. We should keep continuous_batching disabled for MQA routes until we have an eval and load-test. Create follow-up ticket to test batching window tradeoffs with synthetic GQA/MQA distribution.

sofia: filing post-incident: request initial RCA and list of deploys that touched batcher-configmap. Also ask ML infra to simulate warm/cold kv patterns for GQA vs MQA. Assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml.

tariq: I'm taking handoff at 04:30 UTC. Summary for next shift: hotfix rolled (reverted batch_window_ms, disabled continuous_batching for MQA, limited qwen batch tokens). Watch p95 latency and kv_cache_evictions. Pager quieting but alerts remain until 24h baseline confirmed.

support-bot: Sent customer notifications to 7 affected orgs. Ticket IDs: RWD-10234, RWD-10235, RWD-10236.

sara: ok handing off to @tariq. If anything regresses, page the oncall immediately. Postmortem requested by @sofia.

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Pager status: resolved->pending verification. Runbook link and timeline appended.

sofia: extra ask: include perf test that varies batch_window_ms and a synthetic mix with 60% MQA-like prefix churn. Want quantitative curve before we re-enable continuous_batching.

alex: noted. I'll produce load test plan and share results to /docs/incidents/1842103456-batching-loadtests.md. Will include kv eviction curves per model family.

mike: leaving a note: possible long-term fix is partitioned KV namespaces per model-family or smarter key coalescing at batcher to reduce key cardinality. Putting initial design doc in eng-ml draft.

jenny: will follow up with customers with post-incident summary when RCA ready.

sofia: thanks everyone. adding postmortem owner: alex. ETA for draft: 72h. Closing thread (monitor for 24h). :white_check_mark:
